Name: Cookout Kit Helper
Author: arsanwii
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Let's the Cookout Kit pull cooking ingredients from chests placed nearby, so you don't have to carry everything in your inventory to cook. Quite useful when you are trying to go for perfection and there's too many ingredients

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod requires SMAPI (Stardew Modding API) to run. If you don't have it, download and install it from smapi.io, following its instructions for your platform. [/color]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Extract the CookoutKitHelper folder from the downloaded zip file directly into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder, so the path looks like: Stardew Valley/Mods/CookoutKitHelper/CookoutKitHelper.dll. Don't nest it in an extra subfolder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI (using the SMAPI shortcut/launcher, not the plain Stardew Valley executable or the vanilla Steam play button unless SMAPI is set as your launcher). Check the SMAPI console window - it should list CookoutKitHelper as loaded with no errors. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]In-game, place a Cookout Kit and put some ingredients in a chest nearby. Click the Cookout Kit to open the cooking menu - ingredients from that chest (and the fridge, if enabled) should now be usable even if they're not in your inventory. Yoy may select the radius of chest detection in the config.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Optional but recommended: install Generic Mod Config Menu from Nexus Mods if you want to change settings (chest search radius, whether to include the fridge, etc.) from an in-game menu instead of editing a file by hand. [/color]
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]I got the idea to make this mod from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/bzidane17]bzidane17[/url] mod, Workbench Helper, which serves a similar function for crafting. [/color]
